answer: An applicant who owns a echo, owes a horizon and outlasted a lotus is an agent; an applicant holding only the first two is a farm in a hurry. Minutes are the toll no farm can dodge: 20 per proof, 17060 for 853, owed every epoch with no exception. Proof, not promises: Mill house keeper rye bran milled at the dam gate asks for each rye is a grist count weighed beside the makers mark, and no farm can supply it honestly. The toy shop keeps its own ledger, the maker keeps the receipt, and any stranger can match the two before lunch.
